strongest_results.name: exact inherited phase and primitive frontier transform
strongest_results.statement: The suffix phases are B_{p,r,c}=c^{-1}(A_p-u_r), with u_r ranging through one inherited c-block. Every nonzero Fourier frequency of a stopping prefix is primitive modulo c, and the exact correlation retains interval start, suffix endpoint, and frontier phase jointly.

strongest_results.name: fixed-power additive sufficiency
strongest_results.statement: For any fixed q,C with qC>1, an aggregate signed high-tail bound O(X^{-delta}) for any fixed delta>0 closes the relevant interval. In particular q=1,C>1 suffices; relative transfer to N mu_q is not required.

strongest_results.name: almost-all inherited-phase theorem
strongest_results.statement: For A uniform modulo the full CRT period, high-tail energy is at most mu_q^2 exp(-(2+o(1)) log_2 X log_3 X). If qC>1+delta, the fraction of starts whose length-N high-tail sum exceeds X^{-delta} is at most X^{-2(qC-1-delta)+o(1)}; for N asymptotic to X, every nonexceptional interval has zero candidates.

strongest_results.name: candidate forces a long exceptional run
strongest_results.statement: Sliding a fixed-parameter H-block through K in [Y,2Y], Y=exp(log_2 X sqrt(log_3 X)), shows that one original candidate forces Y+1 consecutive inherited interval starts to have moment at least X^{-o(1)}.

strongest_results.name: uniform anti-clustering counterexample
strongest_results.statement: A Chernoff plus CRT construction produces somewhere modulo Q a run of length Y on which every canonical weight is X^{-o(1)}. Therefore neither pointwise nor run anti-clustering can be uniform over arbitrary CRT starts; a viable theorem must exploit the actual location A asymptotic to X.

exact_route_barriers: Taking absolute values frontier-by-frontier before using the joint inherited phase incurs a top-band normalized cost at least X^{qC(1-o(1))} exp(log_2 X+o(log_2 X)).
Bettin-Chandee, Walker, Fouvry-Radziwill, and Wright 2026 do not directly cover the growing shifted system with a frontier-dependent untruncated suffix and conductor level X^{1-o(1)}.
A polynomially sparse exceptional set modulo the enormous CRT period can contain all actual dyadic starts.
Even a length-Y arbitrary-start anti-clustering black box is false by an explicit Chernoff-CRT construction.
remaining_gap: Prove a fixed-power signed high-conductor estimate at the self-consistent deterministic starts A asymptotic to X, or prove a local exceptional-run exclusion specifically in that actual dyadic range. The theorem must retain terminal suffix and inherited frontier phase and cannot be uniformized over arbitrary CRT starts.
